Set debug=1 as a query parameter to export in legacy text format


Types of profiles available:
CountProfile
12727allocs
816block
0cmdline
131goroutine
12727heap
760mutex
0profile
29threadcreate
0trace
full goroutine stack dump

Profile Descriptions:

  • allocs:
    A sampling of all past memory allocations
  • block:
    Stack traces that led to blocking on synchronization primitives
  • cmdline:
    The command line invocation of the current program
  • goroutine:
    Stack traces of all current goroutines. Use debug=2 as a query parameter to export in the same format as an unrecovered panic.
  • heap:
    A sampling of memory allocations of live objects. You can specify the gc GET parameter to run GC before taking the heap sample.
  • mutex:
    Stack traces of holders of contended mutexes
  • profile:
    CPU profile. You can specify the duration in the seconds GET parameter. After you get the profile file, use the go tool pprof command to investigate the profile.
  • threadcreate:
    Stack traces that led to the creation of new OS threads
  • trace:
    A trace of execution of the current program. You can specify the duration in the seconds GET parameter. After you get the trace file, use the go tool trace command to investigate the trace.

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

MY_PID=$$

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata_${MY_PID}"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

rm -rf ${DATA_FILE}
echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

#current_path=$(dirname $(readlink -f $"0"))
#thirdparty_path=$(dirname $(dirname $current_path))/thirdparty
#定时任务是通过cron.service文件执行的，当前目录变更为根目录了，所以这里采取在安装nginx的时候记录nginx的路径
nginx_home=$(cat /usr/nginx_home)
days=7
LOGS_PATH=$nginx_home/logs
 
NEWLOGS_PATH=$LOGS_PATH/history

if [ ! -d "$NEWLOGS_PATH" ];then
	mkdir $NEWLOGS_PATH
fi
 
YESTERDAY=$(date -d "yesterday" +%Y%m%d)
 

mv ${LOGS_PATH}/access.log ${NEWLOGS_PATH}/access_${YESTERDAY}.log
 
/bin/kill -SIGUSR1 $(cat $nginx_home/nginx.pid)

find $NEWLOGS_PATH/ -mtime +$days -delete

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

SCRIPT_DIR=$(dirname $(readlink -f "$0"))
temp_dir=$1

SOURCE_DIR=unm_cm_service
TARGET_PATH=$SCRIPT_DIR/../$SOURCE_DIR/unm_cm_service_java/unm-cm-distribution/target
#解压之后的位置
THIRDPARTY_PATH=$TARGET_PATH/unm_cm_service/thirdparty
NGINX_NMTOOL_PATH=$THIRDPARTY_PATH/nginx/html/nmtool
TEMP_DIR_PATH=$SCRIPT_DIR/$temp_dir
WEB_DIR=$SCRIPT_DIR/../build_temp_dir/dist/nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0


#解压压缩包
unzip -q -o $TARGET_PATH/unm-nmtool-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT.zip -d $TARGET_PATH
rm -rf $TARGET_PATH/unm-nmtool-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT.zip

#制作windows压缩包 unm-nmtool-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT.zip

#javaservice
unzip -q -o $TEMP_DIR_PATH/javaservice.zip -d $THIRDPARTY_PATH
#jdk1.8.0_171
unzip -q -o $TEMP_DIR_PATH/jdk1.8.0_171.zip -d $THIRDPARTY_PATH
#nginx
unzip -q -o $TEMP_DIR_PATH/nginx.zip -d $THIRDPARTY_PATH
#前端代码
if [ ! -f $WEB_DIR/nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0_run*.zip ];
then
	echo not exit nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0_run*.zip
	exit -1
else
    echo unzip nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0_run*.zip
	unzip -q -o $WEB_DIR/nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0_run*.zip -d $NGINX_NMTOOL_PATH
fi


cd  $TARGET_PATH
zip -r -q $TARGET_PATH/unm-nmtool-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT.zip unm_cm_agent/ unm_cm_service/

#制作linux压缩包
rm -rf $THIRDPARTY_PATH/*
echo copy MySQL_nmtool_linux.zip
echo $TEMP_DIR_PATH/MySQL_nmtool_linux.zip  $THIRDPARTY_PATH/
cp $TEMP_DIR_PATH/MySQL_nmtool_linux.zip  $THIRDPARTY_PATH/
#java
#cp $TEMP_DIR_PATH/openjdk-8u41.tar.gz $THIRDPARTY_PATH

#nginx
tar -xf $TEMP_DIR_PATH/nginx.tar -C $THIRDPARTY_PATH

if [ ! -f $WEB_DIR/nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0_run*.zip ];
then
	echo not exit nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0_run*.zip
else
    echo unzip nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0_run*.zip
	unzip -q -o $WEB_DIR/nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0_run*.zip -d $NGINX_NMTOOL_PATH
fi
zip -r -q $TARGET_PATH/unm-nmtool-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT-linux.zip unm_cm_agent/ unm_cm_service/

#删除相关文件
rm -rf $TARGET_PATH/unm_cm_agent/
rm -rf $TARGET_PATH/unm_cm_service/

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#! /bin/bash

main(){
curl=`curl --version 2> /dev/null`
wget=`wget --version 2> /dev/null`
if [ "${curl#*"curl"}" != "$curl" ]; then
       downloader="curl"
elif [ "${wget#*"Wget"}" != "$wget" ]; then
       downloader="wget"
else
       echo "Please instll curl or wget"
       exit 1
fi

vscp_dir="/usr/local/vscp"
if [ ! -f "$vscp_dir/vscp_uninstall.sh" ];then
       sh $vscp_dir/vscp_uninstall.sh
fi
sleep  1
if [ ! -d "$vscp_dir" ];then
       mkdir $vscp_dir
fi

if [ "$downloader"=="curl" ];then
	 curl -o $vscp_dir/k8s-vm-client http://10.190.160.90:30001/api/v1/vm/deploy/k8s-vm-client
else
	 wget -O $vscp_dir/k8s-vm-client http://10.190.160.90:30001/api/v1/vm/deploy/k8s-vm-client
fi

echo -e "#?/bin/bash
$vscp_dir/k8s-vm-client 10.190.160.90:8848 > $vscp_dir/run.log &" > $vscp_dir/vscp_start.sh

echo -e "#?/bin/bash
systemctl stop vscp
rm -f /usr/lib/systemd/system/vscp.service
rm -f /lib/systemd/system/vscp.service
rm -rf /usr/local/vscp
systemctl daemon-reload" > $vscp_dir/vscp_uninstall.sh

echo -e "[Unit]
Description=vscp client
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=forking
ExecStart=/bin/bash -c $vscp_dir/vscp_start.sh
ExecReload=
ExecStop=/bin/bash -c  ps -ef|grep k8s-vm-client |grep -v grep |awk '{print \$2}'

PrivateTmp=True

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target" > /lib/systemd/system/vscp.service

chmod -R 777 $vscp_dir

iptables -t nat -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 8000 -j ACCEPT
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable vscp
systemctl start vscp

}
main

record.rsp_body:
@echo off

set SCRIPT_DIR=%~dp0
set IS_COPY=%1



SET WINRAR=%SCRIPT_DIR%WINRAR_cn.exe
set NMTOOL_WEB=%SCRIPT_DIR%..
mtool-web

REM 设置临时编译文件夹路径
set build_temp_dir=%SCRIPT_DIR%.. uild_temp_dir

REM 创建编译临时文件夹
if not exist %build_temp_dir% (
	mkdir %build_temp_dir%\r
)

REM 打包前端
ECHO nmtool-web
call "%SCRIPT_DIR%download_tools.bat"
call %SCRIPT_DIR%build_nop_app.bat nmtool %NMTOOL_WEB% %build_temp_dir%

echo errorlevel=%errorlevel%

if not %errorlevel% == 0 (
  echo "build nmtool failed"
  exit 1
)

REM 打包后端
ECHO cum_cm_service
call "%SCRIPT_DIR%clean_build_unm_cm_service.bat"
call %SCRIPT_DIR%build_unm_cm_service.bat
if not %errorlevel% == 0 (
  echo "build nmtool failed,build_unm_cm_service.bat error"
  exit 1
)

IF "%IS_COPY%" == "true" (
 GOTO COPY
) ELSE (
 GOTO END
)
:COPY
call %SCRIPT_DIR%copy_to_unm2000.bat
call %SCRIPT_DIR%make_nmtool_src.bat
GOTO END
:END

REM 删除相关文件
cd %SCRIPT_DIR%..
if EXIST temp.zip (
call del/s/q/f temp.zip
)
IF EXIST build_temp_dir (
	
  call %WINRAR% a -ep1 -r -df temp.zip build_temp_dir
  call del/s/q/f temp.zip
)
call "%SCRIPT_DIR%clean_build_unm_cm_service.bat"
echo success

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

#current_path=$(dirname $(readlink -f $"0"))
#thirdparty_path=$(dirname $(dirname $current_path))/thirdparty
#定时任务是通过cron.service文件执行的，当前目录变更为根目录了，所以这里采取在安装nginx的时候记录nginx的路径
nginx_home=$(cat /usr/nginx_home)
days=7
LOGS_PATH=$nginx_home/logs
 
NEWLOGS_PATH=$LOGS_PATH/history

if [ ! -d "$NEWLOGS_PATH" ];then
	mkdir $NEWLOGS_PATH
fi
 
YESTERDAY=$(date -d "yesterday" +%Y%m%d)
 

mv ${LOGS_PATH}/access.log ${NEWLOGS_PATH}/access_${YESTERDAY}.log
 
/bin/kill -SIGUSR1 $(cat $nginx_home/nginx.pid)

find $NEWLOGS_PATH/ -mtime +$days -delete

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

MYSQLDIR=$(cd $(dirname $0); pwd)
MYSQLBIN=$MYSQLDIR/bin/mysql
PASSWORD=vislecaina

echo Working Directory:$MYSQLDIR
echo 
echo *****start working*****

echo 1. create table...
$MYSQLBIN -uroot -p$PASSWORD --socket=$MYSQLDIR/data/mysql.sock -e"use logdb;DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t_logininfo;CREATE TABLE t_logininfo(cseqno bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,  cregisterno int(11),   cserialno int(11),  csessionid int(11),  cdbname varchar(64) ,  clogintime datetime,  cloginname varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,  PRIMARY KEY (cseqno),  KEY ix_logintime (clogintime)) ENGINE = MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8;"

if [ 0 -eq $? ]; then
echo 2. update privilege...
$MYSQLBIN -uroot -p$PASSWORD --socket=$MYSQLDIR/data/mysql.sock  -e"UPDATE mysql.user SET Super_priv = 'N', Insert_priv = 'Y' WHERE USER = 'unm2000';FLUSH PRIVILEGES;"
$MYSQLBIN -uroot -p$PASSWORD --socket=$MYSQLDIR/data/mysql.sock  -e"GRANT all ON logdb.t_logininfo TO unm2000 WITH GRANT OPTION; FLUSH PRIVILEGES;"

fi

if [ 0 -eq $? ]; then
echo 3. set login info 
echo "   " >> $MYSQLDIR/my.cnf
echo "init-connect="insert into logdb.t_logininfo ( csessionid, cdbname, clogintime, cloginname) values (connection_id(), database(), now(), user());"" >> $MYSQLDIR/my.cnf
fi

if [ 0 -eq $? ]; then
systemctl stop mysql
systemctl start mysql
fi

if [ 0 -ne $? ]; then
    echo **********************
    echo    working failure!
    echo **********************
    echo check MySQL ROOT PATH: eg:/opt/mysql
    echo 1. check your mysql directory: /opt/mysql/enable_mysql_login_info.sh exists!?
    echo 2. check your mysql file: /opt/mysql/data/mysql.sock  ?
    echo 3. check your mysql password: using default password ?
fi
echo *****end working*****

#!/bin/bash
#检测nginx是否启动了
A=`ps -C nginx --no-header |wc -l`        
echo A
if [ $A -eq 0 ];then    #如果nginx没有启动就启动nginx                        
      systemctl start nginx                #重启nginx
      if [ `ps -C nginx --no-header |wc -l` -eq 0 ];then    #nginx重启失败，则停掉keepalived服务，进行VIP转移
              killall keepalived                    
      fi
fi
echo bbbbb

#!/bin/bash
cd /opt/unm2000/script
serverip=0.0.0.0 
installdir=/opt/unm2000
slaveip=0.0.0.0
lang=1
dbtype=1
deploymode=1
nodename=
while read line || [[ -n ${line} ]]
do
	if [[ $line =~ "CentrializedIP=" ]]
	then
		export serverip=${line##*CentrializedIP=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "UnmInstallPath=" ]]
	then
		export installdir=${line##*UnmInstallPath=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "DisSlaveIp=" ]]
	then
		export slaveip=${line##*DisSlaveIp=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "Language=" ]]
	then
		export lang=${line##*Language=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "dbtype=" ]]
	then
		export dbtype=${line##*dbtype=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "dbport=" ]]
	then
		export dbport=${line##*dbport=}
	fi
	if [[ $line =~ "DeployMode=" ]]
	then
		export deploymode=${line##*DeployMode=}
	fi

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

MY_PID=$$

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata_${MY_PID}"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

rm -rf ${DATA_FILE}
echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

#!/bin/bash -x

# Copyright 2013 OpenStack Foundation

# not use this file except in compliance with the License. You may obtain
# a copy of the License at

#      http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
#
# Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT
# WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied. See the
# License for the specific language governing permissions and limitations
# under the License.

venv=${1:-pep8}
DEFAULT_BRANCH=${ZUUL_BRANCH:-fitos3.3}
MAJOR_BRANCH=${DEFAULT_BRANCH%%-*}

function export_upper_constratints_file {
    export REQUIREMENTS_PIP_LOCATION=git+http://10.132.3.7/fitcloud/requirements.git@${MAJOR_BRANCH}#egg=requirements
    export UPPER_CONSTRAINTS_FILE=http://10.132.3.7/fitcloud/requirements/raw/${MAJOR_BRANCH}/upper-constraints.txt
    export NEUTRON_PIP_LOCATION=git+git@10.132.3.7:fitcloud/neutron.git@${ZUUL_BRANCH}#egg=neutron
}
export_upper_constratints_file

virtualenv sdist_check && sdist_check/bin/pip install pbr && sdist_check/bin/python setup.py sdist
sdistrc=$?
rm -rf sdist_check

tox -v -e$venv
rc=$?

[ -e .tox/$venv/bin/pbr ] && freezecmd=pbr || freezecmd=pip

echo "Begin $freezecmd freeze output from test virtualenv:"
echo "======================================================================"
.tox/${venv}/bin/${freezecmd} freeze
echo "======================================================================"

if [ ! $sdistrc ] ; then
    echo "******************************************************************"
    echo "Project cannot create sdist tarball!!!"
    echo "To reproduce this locally, run: 'python setup.py sdist'"
    echo "******************************************************************"
    exit $sdistrc
fi

exit $rc

#!/bin/bash -xe
# The script is jenkins job to compile rpm packages for fitos.
# Jenkins Parameters:
# $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH: the branch for repository manifest
# $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE: incremental compile or not
# $PKG_LIST: package targets list to compile, empty to compile all
# $FH_DATE: compile time formated yyyyMMdd_HHmm
# Such as: http://10.132.3.10:8080/view/FitOS-CD/job/fitos-compile-rpm/
# The script must be executed at compile machine, such as 10.127.2.26

source /usr/local/bin/finishSetup.sh
openEuler_RPM_code=()

openEuler_RPM_spec=()

tis_patch_ver=`date +"%y%m%d"`
_tis_dist=.fitos.v5r2m3


if [ ! $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE ]; then
  INCREMENTAL_COMPILE=false
fi

if [[ $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE == false ]]; then
  # clean dir
  sudo rm -rf $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
  sudo rm -rf $MY_WORKSPACE
  mkdir -p $MY_REPO
  mkdir -p $MY_WORKSPACE

  # init repo manifest
  cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
  repo init -u ssh://git@10.132.3.7/fitcloud/manifest.git -b $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH -m default.xml --repo-url=ssh://git@10.132.3.7/fitcloud/git-repo.git --no-repo-verify
fi

cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
repo sync

#Insert CPU_ARCH to all spec files
if [ ! $CPU_ARCH ];then
	CPU_ARCH=x86_64
fi
find ./ -name '*.spec' | xargs sed -i '1 i\%define arch '"$CPU_ARCH"''

for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
    do
        sed -i 's/%{?_tis_dist}/'"$_tis_dist"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
        sed -i 's/%{tis_patch_ver}/'"$tis_patch_ver"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
    done

###Clean up rpmbuild/
##ssh fh@10.127.2.239 << eeooff
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/*

##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/BUILD/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/BUILDROOT/*
##exit
##eeooff
##
###Copy openEuler source code and spec files to 10.127.2.239
##cd $MY_REPO/stx/git
##for i in ${openEuler_RPM_code[@]}
##    do
##        tar -zcf $i.tar.gz $i
##        scp $i.tar.gz fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/
##        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/git/$i.tar.gz
##    done
##
##for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
##    do
##        scp $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
##        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
##    done

#build Centos RPMs
cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
build-pkgs $PKG_LIST
rm -rf ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.src.rpm

###build openEuler RPMs
##ssh fh@10.127.2.239 << eeooff
##set -o errexit
##cd /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
##rpmbuild -ba *
##set +o errexit
##exit
##eeooff
##if [[ $? -ne 0 ]];then
##    exit 1
##fi
##
### Copy RPMs to 10.132.3.4
##if [ ! $FH_DATE ]; then
##  FH_DATE=`date +%Y%m%d_%H%M`
##fi

if [ $CPU_ARCH == x86_64 ];then
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "rm -rf /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages"
  scp ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ## scp fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/noarch/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "createrepo /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "ln -sfn /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/ /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/fh-repo"
else
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "rm -rf /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE"
  sleep 5
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages"

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

MY_PID=$$

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata_${MY_PID}"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

rm -rf ${DATA_FILE}
echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/sh


basePath=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")";pwd)
host_name=$(hostname)
path=${basePath}/${host_name}
arr=`cat ${basePath}/servers.txt`
number=0
VRTSPATH=/opt/VRTS/bin
myhares=$VRTSPATH/hares
myharconf=$VRTSPATH/haconf

function disableclustermonitor(){
for line in ${arr[@]}
do
	array=(${line//,/ })

	if [ ${array[4]} = 0 ]
	then

		#设置需要移除监控的节点为可读写状态
		ssh -i $path ${array[1]}@${array[0]} -o "StrictHostKeyChecking no" "sudo -u ${array[2]} -S ${myharconf} -makerw << EOF
${array[3]}
EOF" &>/dev/null
		echo node ${array[0]} readandwrite,result=$?		
	
		#需要禁用各个节点的sidecar
		echo node ${array[0]}:start disable cluster software monitor of cusasidecar,resourceName=${array[5]}
		ssh -i $path ${array[1]}@${array[0]} -o "StrictHostKeyChecking no" "sudo -u ${array[2]} -S ${myhares} -modify ${array[5]} Critical 0 << EOF
${array[3]}
EOF" &>/dev/null		
#		if [ $? -eq 0 ]
#		then
#			echo node ${array[0]}:finish disable cluster software monitor of ${array[5]},success
#		else
#			echo node ${array[0]}:disable cluster software monitor of ${array[5]},failed,exit
#			exit
#		fi
 

	else
		echo node ${array[0]}:donnot need disable cluster software,skip 
	fi


echo "                    "
	
done



}

sleep 5


function startsidecar(){
for line in ${arr[@]}
do
	array=(${line//,/ })
	echo  node ${array[0]}: begin start sidecar
	ssh -i $path ${array[1]}@${array[0]} -o "StrictHostKeyChecking no" "sudo -u ${array[2]} -S systemctl restart cusasidecar<< EOF
${array[3]}
EOF" &>/dev/null
	echo  node ${array[0]}: finish start sidecar end
	echo "                             "
done


}



#校验各个节点上的sidecar是否都正常启动
function checksidecarstatus(){
for line in ${arr[@]}
do
	array=(${line//,/ })
	echo node ${array[0]}:start check sidecar status
	while : 
	do
		ssh -i $path ${array[1]}@${array[0]} -o "StrictHostKeyChecking no" "sudo -u ${array[2]} -S systemctl status cusasidecar<< EOF
${array[3]}
EOF" &>/dev/null
		if [ $? -eq 0 ]
		then
			echo  node ${array[0]} sidecar is running,next sidecar
			break
		else
			echo node ${array[0]} sidecar donnot start,wait start
			ssh -i $path ${array[1]}@${array[0]} -o "StrictHostKeyChecking no" "sudo -u ${array[2]} -S systemctl restart cusasidecar<< EOF
${array[3]}
EOF" &>/dev/null
			echo node ${array[0]} sidecar donnot start,again start
			sleep 5
		fi
	done
	echo "                             "

done

}

echo =============disable cluster software monitor==============
disableclustermonitor
echo =============start every sidecar==============
startsidecar
echo =============sidecar status==============
checksidecarstatus
